text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
After leaving the reindeer to deal with their pursuers,
the three Santa candidates get away from town.
text_block_list.orig_text:
追っ手をトナカイたちに任せた３人のサンタ候補たちは、
町から少し離れた場所へとやってきていた。

text_block_list.name: Christina
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm. Elizabeth Park, was it?
It's certainly been a while.
When was the last time...? Well, it doesn't really matter.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふむ。
【牧場（エリザベスパーク）】だったか？
ここを訪れるのは久しぶりだな。
前はいつだったか……
まぁそんなことはどうでもいいことか。

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
It appears to be rather dilapidated...
Are there actually people living here?
text_block_list.orig_text:
何やら随分と荒れておるのう……？
こんなところに人がおるのか？

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text:
No, I don't think that's the case...
But what on earth happened here?
The fences and stuff are all falling apart.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いえ、
そんなことはないと思いますけど……
でも
本当にどうしたんだろう？　
柵とかボロボロ……

text_block_list.name: Mahiru
text_block_list.text:
Hey now, what's all this racket...?
Y'all are gonna make me have a cow at this rate.
text_block_list.orig_text:
も～
なんなんだべ～……
思わず牛みたいな鳴き声あげちまうよ～

text_block_list.name: Mahiru
text_block_list.text:
Hm? {0}?
Sorry, I can't think of nothin' funny right now.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん？　
{0}だべか？
ごめんよぉ
オラ、
今ちょっと面白いボケも出てこねぇべ～

text_block_list.name: Mahiru
text_block_list.text:
I'm havin' a bad day.
Even though it's the festive season and all, it's been udder chaos...
A real crappy holiday... so I just can't laugh.
text_block_list.orig_text:
今日は厄日だべよ～
クリスマスだってのに、
苦しんでばかり……
これがほんとのクルシミマス、
って……
笑えねぇべ……

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
Yet you jest much more than one would expect.
Tell us, cow girl, what in the blazes happened here?
text_block_list.orig_text:
思ったより余裕があるようじゃの。
それで牛の小娘、
ここで何があったのじゃ？

text_block_list.name: Mahiru
text_block_list.text:
What's with all the Santas?
An ensemble garbed in the same ensemble.
Comediennes...? No, street performers?
text_block_list.orig_text:
何だべ、
アンタら？
揃いも揃ってサンタの服着て。
漫才師……
いや、
大道芸人だべか？

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Ummm... Yeah, something like that.
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっと……
そんな感じ、
かな？

text_block_list.name: Mahiru
text_block_list.text:
Well, if you'll hear me out, I'll talk.
...Today's just been one disaster after another.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まぁ、
聞いてもらえるならお話しすっべ。
……今日は災難続きなんだべよ。

text_block_list.name: Mahiru
text_block_list.text:
First off, I made a whole load o' puddin'
to sell as a new product at Elizabeth Park.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まず、
牧場で新しく売り出そうと思って
プリンをいっぱい作ってたんだべ。

text_block_list.name: Mahiru
text_block_list.text:
But just as I finished up, a reindeer came outta nowhere 
and just swiped it all away!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そしたら何か、
トナカイがすごい勢いでやってきて、
そのプリンを全部持って行っちまったんだよ～

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: ...Producer...
text_block_list.orig_text: ……プロデューサー……

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: ...Christina....
text_block_list.orig_text: ……クリスティーナ……

text_block_list.name: Christina
text_block_list.text:
Don't point those fiery daggers in my direction.
I'll get third-degree burns... ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
熱い眼差しをこちらに向けないでくれ。
火傷してしまいそうだ……♪

text_block_list.name: Mahiru
text_block_list.text:
An' that ain't the half of it! I was out shovelin' snow
when a torrent of crazy magic came rainin' down outta nowhere!
Now the fences I just fixed are all smashed up again!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それだけじゃないべ！
表で雪かきしてたら、
何かとんでもねぇ魔法さ降ってくるし！
直したばかりだった柵が
この有様だべ！

text_block_list.name: Christina
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Illya Ornstein.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……おい、
イリヤ・オーンスタイン。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: ...That was Matsuri's...
text_block_list.orig_text: ……それってマツリちゃんの……

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
It was me?! The fault was mine?!
Urghhh...
text_block_list.orig_text:
わらわか！？　
わらわのせいなのか！？
ううむ……

text_block_list.name: Mahiru
text_block_list.text:
Because of that, I ain't got nothin' to sell,
and I gotta pitchfork out for repairs!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おかげでうちは売る商品がなくなって、
牧場の修繕費まで必要なんだべさ～！

text_block_list.name: Mahiru
text_block_list.text:
At this rate, we ain't gonna make it through the winter!
Urghhh, I feel so bad for the residents of Elizabeth Park!
text_block_list.orig_text:
これじゃあこの冬さ越せないべ～！
うぅ、
ごめんよぉ
牧場のみんな～！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text:
A present...!
Yeah, let's do that, {0}!
text_block_list.orig_text:
プレゼント……！
そう、
そうだよねっ！　{0}くん！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: We are Santa Claus... candidates after all!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わらわたちは
サンタクロース……
候補じゃったな！

text_block_list.name: Christina
text_block_list.text:
The boy is right.
To those lamenting their misfortune, are we not duty bound to consign good luck...? ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
坊やの言う通りだ。
不運を嘆く者にこそ
幸運を配ろうじゃないか……♪

text_block_list.name: Christina
text_block_list.text:
In other words, we must restore Elizabeth Park, correct?
Management happens to be a specialty of mine. ☆
I have an idea.
text_block_list.orig_text:
要するに
この牧場を再興させればよいのだろう？
経営ならお安い御用☆
ワタシに考えがある。

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
Hold your reindeer, Christina.
I too have a glimmer of an idea.
text_block_list.orig_text:
待つがよいクリスティーナ。
わらわも閃いたのじゃ！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text:
It's gonna be okay, right...?
Whose idea do you think will be better, {0}?
choice_data_list: I want to see Christina's idea.
I want to see Illya's idea.
text_block_list.orig_text:
だ、
大丈夫かな……？
{0}くんはどっちの案がいいと思う？

text_block_list.name: Christina
text_block_list.text: Very well.
text_block_list.orig_text: 良かろう。

text_block_list.name: Christina
text_block_list.text:
Those around me seem to believe that I can only live on the battlefield.
But I'll have you know, I am also a shrewd businesswoman.
Consulting is easier than wielding a sword.
text_block_list.orig_text:
周りはワタシを血生臭い鉄火場でしか生きられんと
思っているようだが、
実は事業経営なんかもやっていてね。
コンサルタントなら剣を振るより易い。

text_block_list.name: Christina
text_block_list.text:
Mahiru, was it? You are the manager, correct?
Your pudding idea was right on the mark.
Having a specialty is the basis of all commerce.
text_block_list.orig_text:
マヒルとか言ったな？　
経営者はオマエでいいんだな？
プリンという着眼点は良い。
名物を作ろうとするのは経営の基本だ。

text_block_list.name: Mahiru
text_block_list.text: Ah, thank ya...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ、
ありがとうだべ……？

text_block_list.name: Christina
text_block_list.text:
However, it is not acceptable for pudding to be the only product you sell.
Even if your customer pulling power increases, it will only be temporary.
text_block_list.orig_text:
だが売りがプリンだけというのはいただけん。
集客力が一時的に上がっても
それでは長続きしない。

text_block_list.name: Mahiru
text_block_list.text:
Aha... I think I get what you're sayin'.
So whaddya reckon I should do...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほうほう……
なんとなく分かるんだけど、
結局どうしたらいいんだべか……？

text_block_list.name: Christina
text_block_list.text:
If you wish to sell food, 
then seize control of the stomachs of each and every customer.
text_block_list.orig_text:
食を売るなら、
客の胃をすべて掌握しろ。

text_block_list.name: Christina
text_block_list.text:
Commandeer their culinary cravings,
and hold them captive until they are fully satiated.
That's how to do business... ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
ここを訪れた客の胃を完全に掴み、
満腹になるまで帰さない。
そういう商売をするのさ……♪

text_block_list.name: Mahiru
text_block_list.text:
Th-that's a fantastic idea...!
How should I go about it?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
な、
何だかすごそうだべ……！
どうしたらいいんだべさ……！？

text_block_list.name: Christina
text_block_list.text: Hmmm...
text_block_list.orig_text: うむ──

text_block_list.name: Christina
text_block_list.text: Establish a steakhouse here!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ここにステーキハウスを作る！

text_block_list.name: Mahiru
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Christina
text_block_list.text: Fortunately, it seems you have... good quality ingredients here.
text_block_list.orig_text:
幸いにもここには……
良質な素材が揃っているようだしな。

text_block_list.name: Mahiru
text_block_list.text:
Th-there ain't no way!
Everyone on the ranch is like one big, happy family!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ダっ、
ダメだべよ！？
牧場にいる子らは
家族みてぇなもんだべ！

text_block_list.name: Christina
text_block_list.text:
Rest assured.
I shall guarantee the taste.
text_block_list.orig_text:
安心しろ。
味はワタシが保証しよう。

text_block_list.name: Mahiru
text_block_list.text: That ain't what I mean!
text_block_list.orig_text: そういうことじゃねぇべ～～～～～！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: Very good, very good.
text_block_list.orig_text: そうじゃろそうじゃろ。

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: From the looks of it, despite this ranch being large, there are few animals.
text_block_list.orig_text:
見たところ
この牧場、
広いわりに動物が少ないと見える。

text_block_list.name: Mahiru
text_block_list.text:
Sure, I'd love a large ranch with lotsa animals,
but we just ain't got enough manpower, so carin' for 'em all'd be pretty tough.
Any more chores, an' Rinrin, Shioshio, an' Limalima are sure to keel over.
text_block_list.orig_text:
動物たくさんの大牧場にもあこがれるけども、
人手があまりいねぇから
世話しきれないっべよ。
リンリンやシオシオ、
リマリマの負担は
これ以上増やせないっべ。

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I can tell you lack servants simply by looking.
However, it must not be so.
People tend to shy away from deserted, rueful places such as this.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うむ。
人手不足なのは見れば分かる。
じゃが
それではいかん。
閑散とした場所に
人間は近寄らんからのう。

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: Hence, my gift to you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
というわけで、
わらわからプレゼントじゃ。

text_block_list.name: Mahiru
text_block_list.text:
Huh...?
Somethin' feels kinda weird... The wind is pickin' up...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん……？
何か
妙な気配が……
風がざわざわしてきたべ……？

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
Now that I am in my original form,
I can put my underlings to work at will!
Come now, my servants!
text_block_list.orig_text:
元の姿に戻っておる今、
配下たちを使役することも意のままよ！
さぁ来るがよい！　
我が配下たち！

text_block_list.name: Mahiru
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what's goin' on?!
Holy cow! Th-there's bats comin' from all over the place!
text_block_list.orig_text:
な、
何だべ～！？
こりゃたまげたべや、
そ、
そこら中から蝙蝠が！？

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
Heheheh! What say you? Adorable, are they not?!
They are numerous and easy to handle.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふっふっふ。
どうじゃ
かわいかろう！
こやつらは手もかからぬし、
数も多いからの！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
With them, Elizabeth Park will become livelier,
and visitors are sure to come in droves.
text_block_list.orig_text:
これで牧場も賑やかになって、
人がたくさんやってくるというわけじゃ！

text_block_list.name: Mahiru
text_block_list.text:
There ain't no way that's happenin'!
The ranch turned so black so fast,
I oughtta be callin' it Elizabeth Dark!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんなわけねぇべ！？
牧場があっという間に黒く染まって、
墨汁をこぼしたみたいだべや～！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
You managed to make a joke out of that...?
You truly are adept...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
牧場と墨汁をかけておるのか……
やりおるわい……！

text_block_list.name: Mahiru
text_block_list.text:
Oh, really?!
I gotta write that down— Wait, no!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
ほんとだべ！
メモしとかねぇと……
じゃなくて！

text_block_list.name: Mahiru
text_block_list.text:
Look!
The animals are all kickin' up a fuss!
text_block_list.orig_text:
見るべ！
うちの動物たちも怯えちまってるべよ！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: Hrk. Urgh... It appears bats were the wrong call...
text_block_list.orig_text:
う、
ぬう……
蝙蝠はダメじゃったか……

text_block_list.name: Mahiru
text_block_list.text: Hurry and get 'em outta here!
text_block_list.orig_text: 早く帰らせるべ～～～～～！

text_block_list.name: Mahiru
text_block_list.text:
*sigh...* We ain't survivin' this winter after all...
We're all gonna freeze in this frigid weather...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ……
やっぱり冬は越せねぇべ……
寒空の下、
オラたちは凍えて過ごすんだべ～……！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Don't give up... There must be a way!
text_block_list.orig_text:
諦めちゃ……
ダメだよっ！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: We're bound to think of something!
text_block_list.orig_text:
私たちがっ、
何とかっ、
してみせるからっ！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
...Hm?
Nozomi, what have you been doing all this time?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……む？
ノゾミよ、
さっきから何をやっておるのじゃ？

text_block_list.name: Christina
text_block_list.text:
From over here,
it looks as though you're excavating random holes in the ground...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ワタシには、
ピッケルを持って適当な地面を掘っているように見えるぞ……？

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Elizabeth Park is really big, and the scenery is beautiful!
text_block_list.orig_text:
この牧場っ、
広くてっ、
景色もっ、
きれいだからっ！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: So I thought it would be nice if there was a hot spring or something here!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こういう場所に、
温泉とか、
あったら、
なぁって！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
I-I see...
I believe I grasp the concept...
text_block_list.orig_text:
な、
なるほど……
考えは分かったがのう……

text_block_list.name: Christina
text_block_list.text:
Ahahah. ☆ To think up such an idea and put it into action
is no less than what I would expect from the Carmina idol
who can make even crying children laugh.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっはは☆
それを思いついて実行に移すとは、
さすがは泣く子も笑う
【カルミナ】のアイドル。

text_block_list.name: Christina
text_block_list.text:
However, although I admire your slow-and-steady attitude,
merely digging like that will get you nowhere.
Gouging out a hot spring by hand is unrealistic in the first place.
text_block_list.orig_text:
だがな、
雨垂れ石を穿つの精神は買うが、
そのまま掘り続けても埒があかんぞ？
そもそも人の手で掘るのは現実的ではないからな。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text:
But still!
I'm...!
A Santa Claus... candidate!
choice_data_list: A miracle is bound to happen.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それでも！
私はっ！
サンタクロース──
候補ですからっ！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: I know, right?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うんっ！　
そうだよね……！

text_block_list.name: Mahiru
text_block_list.text: Y'all would... do this much for Elizabeth Park...?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
アンタら……
牧場のために、
ここまで……！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
...Now I understand.
This is one of those fabled holiday miracles.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……なるほどのう。
クリスマスの奇跡というやつか。

text_block_list.name: Christina
text_block_list.text: Why is it that I now find myself believing...? ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
なぜだろうな？
信じてみたくなったよ……♪

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Producer, Illya!
text_block_list.orig_text:
プロデューサー、
イリヤさん！

text_block_list.name: Christina
text_block_list.text:
Illya Ornstein.
Do you think you have it in you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
イリヤ・オーンスタイン。
いけるか？

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
'Tis but a trifle.
On the contrary, holding back is the struggle.
text_block_list.orig_text:
容易い容易い。
手加減の方が難しいくらいじゃ。

text_block_list.name: Christina
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, vacate the area.
Do not blame me if you get caught up in it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
全員ここから離れていろ。
巻き込まれても恨むなよ？

text_block_list.name: Mahiru
text_block_list.text: C-caught up in what...?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
な、
何が始まるんだべ……！？

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Mahiru, you too...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
マヒルさん、
キミもこっちに……！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: Here I go—Vermilion Bite!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ゆくぞ──
ヴァーミリオンバイト！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Amazing! She exposed the bedrock in an instant!
text_block_list.orig_text:
すごい！　
地面が一気に抉れて……！

text_block_list.name: Christina
text_block_list.text:
Now it's my turn to let off a little steam... ☆
Numbers Avalon!
text_block_list.orig_text:
さぁて出てこい、
鬼でも蛇でも、温泉でも……☆
──乱数聖域！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: A hot spring...
text_block_list.orig_text: 出た……

text_block_list.name: Christina
text_block_list.text: A hot spring.
text_block_list.orig_text: 出たな。

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: 'Tis a hot spring.
text_block_list.orig_text: 出たのう。

text_block_list.name: Mahiru
text_block_list.text: I-it's like a dream...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ゆ、
夢みたいだべ……

text_block_list.name: Mahiru
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe it! A real hot spring!
This'll be the centerpiece of Elizabeth Park!
text_block_list.orig_text:
すごいべ！　
温泉だべ！
これなら、
【牧場（エリザベスパーク）】の大きな目玉になるべよ！

text_block_list.name: Mahiru
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry for callin' y'all street performers!
Y'all are the real thing!
text_block_list.orig_text:
大道芸人だなんて言って悪かったべ！
アンタらは本物のサンタクロースだべさ！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Eheh. Glad you feel that way!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ。
良かったですね！

text_block_list.name: Elite Reindeer 2
text_block_list.text:
Brooough...?
(What are they up to this time...?)
text_block_list.orig_text:
ブオオオ……？
（今度は何やってるの……？）

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Oh, the reindeer—they have finally returned!
What impeccable timing!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん？　
おぉ
トナカイたち、
ようやく戻ったか！
実にいいタイミングではないか！

text_block_list.name: Elite Reindeer 2
text_block_list.text:
B-brooough?
(I've got a bad feeling about this.)
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ブ、
ブオ？
（……い、嫌な予感）

text_block_list.name: Christina
text_block_list.text:
We're about to commence constructing a hot spring here,
so you'll be gathering the materials for us.
We'll build a grand tourist destination to my liking... ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
今からここに温泉を作るから、
材料を集めてきてくれ。
ワタシ好みの豪勢な観光名所にしてやるさ……♪

text_block_list.name: Elite Reindeer 1
text_block_list.text:
Broooooooooough?!
(Hot spriiiiiiiiiing?!)
text_block_list.orig_text:
ブオオーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーッ！？
（温泉ーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーっ！？）

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
And so came to be Elizabeth Park's newest attraction—
the hot spring.
text_block_list.orig_text:
こうして【牧場（エリザベスパーク）】に、
温泉という新たな観光名所が誕生したのであった。

text_block_list.name: Elite Reindeer 1
text_block_list.text:
Brooough, brooough!
(I can't take it anymore! I've had it up to my neck... no, my antlers, with you!
What do you think we are?!)
text_block_list.orig_text:
ブオオオウ、
ブオウ！
（もう限界だ！　今度こそ頭に……いや角に来た！
俺たちトナカイを何だと思ってるんだ！）

text_block_list.name: Elite Reindeer 2
text_block_list.text:
Brooough, brooough!
(Damn holiday! Year after year we have to run around all over the place!
I want to make them understand how we feel!)
text_block_list.orig_text:
ブオオオ、
ブオオオオ！
（何がクリスマスだ、毎年毎年駆け回らされて、
あいつらに俺たちの気持ちを味わわせてやりたいよ！）

text_block_list.name: Elite Reindeer 3
text_block_list.text:
...Brrgh, brooough.
(...I think I have an idea.)
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ブブゥ、
ブオンオ。
（……それなら、いい考えがある）

text_block_list.name: Mahiru
text_block_list.text:
Feels like I've seen these reindeer before...
Where was it now...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
このトナカイたち、
何かどっかで見た気がするべ……
どこでだったかなぁ……？
